rawCommits.subject: perf(agents): paint sidebar from cache on warm load and commit list before CEO setup
rawCommits.body:
Agents took a long time to appear on a warm load while Projects were instant.
Two data-path fixes bring Agents to parity:

- Hydrate the IndexedDB agent cache on module init when a user is already
  authenticated, and re-fetch the org-scoped fleet when the active org settles.
  The auth-change subscription only fired on a userId transition, which the
  lazily-imported store missed on warm loads, so cached agents never painted and
  the list waited for the network. Mirrors the projects store, which hydrates on
  both org- and auth-settle. Cache hydration now also no-ops if a fresh network
  result already landed, so the async read can't clobber it.

- Commit the agent list immediately after `agents.list` resolves, then run the
  idempotent `superAgent.setup()` (CEO + Home ensure) as a follow-up that
  patches in any newly-created agent. Previously the first render was gated
  behind that extra round-trip (and an occasional cleanup + relist). Empty lists
  still wait for setup since there is nothing to show yet.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: perf(agents): paint sidebar from cache on warm load and commit list before CEO setup

Runs in the authenticated session so the JWT is threaded automatically: create note, upload markdown body to S3 via presign, set blog metadata + byline + sortOrder, then publish. rawCommits.subject: perf(agents): make sidebar rows pure + lazy-load avatars so switches are instant
rawCommits.body:
Agents rendered slower than Projects on every Agents <-> Projects switch. Both
panes are kept alive, but the virtualizer drops its row window while a pane is
display:none and re-mounts it on reveal. Each AgentConversationRow re-mounted
~9 store subscriptions (useAvatarState x2, useIsAgentBusy x4, pinned, LoopProgress,
preview) plus an image decode, while project rows are pure and carry none.

Decouple the per-row work from the render loop:

- Centralize the reads in a batched, list-level zustand hook (useAgentRowModels)
  that resolves status / busy / loop activity / pinned / preview for every agent
  once and hands each row a plain AgentRowModel. Rows are now pure and props-driven
  like project rows, so re-mounting on a switch carries no subscriptions. Extracts
  a pure LoopProgressView and a shared resolveAvatarState; exports aggregateRows.

- Lazy-load the avatar image after first paint (useAfterPaint) so the decode never
  blocks the switch frame; a seen-set skips the defer on warm re-mounts to avoid
  flicker. Adds decoding="async" to the avatar img.

Tests: AgentConversationRow becomes a props-rendering suite; the busy-aggregation
coverage moves to a new use-agent-row-models suite; adds a use-after-paint test;
AgentList stubs the model hook (covered separately) but still sources preview from
the mocked cache.

rawCommits.subject: fix(remote-agents): recover stalled CEO/remote chat turns
rawCommits.body:
Two independent defects made a restored remote (CEO) agent unusable, surfacing as 'Remote agent did not emit any stream events within 180s', a local timeout, and a hard 'Chat stream interrupted' bubble.

Server: recovering or running a lifecycle action (stop/restart/start/wake/hibernate) on a remote VM recycles the harness run but left the warm chat_session in the registry pointing at the dead WS. ChatSession::is_alive only checks the command channel, so the next turn reused it and stalled until the 180s first-event watchdog fired. Add AppState::evict_chat_sessions_for_agent (backed by a registry-level free fn) and call it from recover_remote_agent_pipeline and remote_agent_lifecycle; the existing update sweep now delegates to it.

Client: the standalone-agent chat hook passed only event.content.message to handleStreamError, dropping the error code so stream_stalled/turn_timeout never classified as a recoverable streamDropped, and it had no auto-retry. Pass the full payload and add a tryAutoRetry mirroring project chat (reconnect-first, then replay the last send, bounded by MAX_AUTO_RETRIES) on both the Error frame and transport-level onError.

Tests: unit-test the registry eviction (target-only + no-op cases) and add a hook test asserting a stream_stalled error auto-reconnects without a hard error bubble or a duplicated user message.
Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: recover stalled CEO/remote chat turns

rawCommits.subject: feat(analytics): forward user IP on server session_active for geo
rawCommits.body:
Server-emitted session_active (the authoritative True DAU source) posted
directly to Mixpanel with no ip property, so events geolocated to the
server's IP instead of the user's, leaving country breakdowns useless.
Forward the caller's IP (X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP) as the ip property
so Mixpanel resolves $country_code/$region/$city from the user, matching
the browser SDK's ip:true behavior. Loopback/missing IPs are dropped so
we never emit misleading geo.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

rendered.title: Agent cards, a public blog, and a sidebar that stays put
rendered.intro: A heavy interface day: the agent profile got a hybrid 3D nameplate + glass spec card, Notes was rebuilt onto a storage-backed ID model that also powers a brand-new public /blog site, and the sidebar gained an Agents/Projects rocker plus a persistent chat surface so switching apps no longer remounts your conversation. Settings grew real theme sub-areas, and several reliability fixes landed for remote agents, geo analytics, and production CSS.

entries.title: Council mechanism picker and a redesigned agent profile card
entries.summary: The council UI got a clearer mechanism picker that persists across reloads, and the agent profile was split into a slim 3D nameplate plus a separate spec card.

items.text: Replaced the finicky hover flyout on the council count with an always-visible Synthesize / Contrast / Side-by-side menu row, and persisted the chosen mechanism on the parent tool_use block so a reloaded turn shows the correct label on the council panel header.

Split the agent profile into a shortened WebGL worn-metal nameplate (name, role, engraved status on the frame) and a new DOM ProfileSpecCard carrying Organization, IP, Wallet, channel logos, and Skills/Connectors/Permissions links, with a black-glass treatment and trimmed nameplate sizing.

Remote-agent status card now offers a Recovery action when the VM state fetch fails recoverably (e.g. 404 'machine gone'), instead of stranding the user with only a Report bug button; 401 session-expired still surfaces report-only.

entries.title: Frosted glass panels restored in production desktop builds
entries.summary: Pinned the Vite CSS minifier so backdrop-filter and color-mix declarations survive into release bundles.

items.text: Vite 8's default Lightning CSS minifier was stripping the glass panel recipe (backdrop-filter / color-mix) from production CSS, so release desktop builds lost their frosted blur. Pinned cssMinify to esbuild so prod renders the same glass as the dev server.

entries.title: In-app Changelog/Downloads modals, LOCAL agent badge, and tunable glass
entries.summary: Help menu entries now stay inside the app, local agents are visually distinct on the 3D card, and glass blur/opacity became user-tunable.

items.text: Help → Changelog and Help → Downloads now open inside zui modals (with a 20% wider layout) rather than navigating away, keeping users in the app shell when logged in.
Local agents now render a purple LOCAL badge on the 3D card frame while remote agents keep their live green/red VM status, and the channel bar picks up the LLM input pill gradient.
Added a tunable glass blur/opacity level exposed through Appearance settings, with a panel glass bridge wiring the new variables into existing surfaces.
Mixpanel client init now opts into IP geolocation so events like user_signed_up can be broken down by country, region, and city; DNT/GPC opt-out behavior is unchanged.

entries.title: Typed notes/folders/comments client in aura-os-storage
entries.summary: Added a typed Rust client surface for the storage service's notes entity, unblocking the storage-backed notes rewrite.

items.text: Mirrored the aura-storage notes entity with StorageNote, StorageNoteFolder, and StorageNoteComment models, request types, and a StorageClient method set covering both public and internal note routes, plus in-memory mock coverage for integration tests.

entries.title: Storage-backed Notes, aura-blog CMS, and a public /blog site
entries.summary: Notes moved off the filesystem onto a storage-backed ID model with markdown bodies on S3, and that same backend powers a new public blog with a sidebar rocker to flip between Agents and Projects.

items.text: Replaced the filesystem notes layer end-to-end: the server now serves storage-backed, ID-based notes with markdown bodies on S3, the frontend store/UI was rewritten off relPath onto stable UUIDs with autosave via uploadMarkdown, and a sys-admin importer ports legacy filesystem notes over.

Added an aura-blog CMS surface inside Notes (sys-admin gated blog fields, publish, status badges) plus a new public /blog index and /blog/:slug post page styled after cursor.com/blog, fed by anonymous /api/public/blog endpoints and S3 markdown bodies, with a Blog entry in the public top nav and mobile drawer.

Introduced a neumorphic Agents/Projects rocker switch at the top of the shared sidebar, iterated through several physical models (rigid plate → center-folding rocker → flat plate-mounted toggle), and tuned the shared bright-to-dark border gradient and motion so the selected side reads as raised and the click feels instant.

entries.title: Persistent chat surface, Theme drill-down, and remote-agent recovery
entries.summary: A long afternoon of polish around the new sidebar rocker landed a shell-level conversation host, a real Theme settings section, performance work on the agent list, and reliability fixes for stalled remote-agent turns and geo analytics.

items.text: Mounted a shell-level ConversationSurfaceHost keyed by projectId + agentInstanceId so the agent chat survives every Agents ⇄ Projects switch with no remount or refetch, and made AppSwitchToggle resolve the equivalent lane in the target app so the toggle lands on the same mounted chat.

Made app-switching feel instant: keep both panes mounted via memoized keep-alive wrappers, virtualize the agents list with an O(1) busy index, centralize per-row store reads behind useAgentRowModels so rows are pure props, lazy-load avatars after first paint, and hydrate the agent IndexedDB cache on warm loads so the sidebar paints before the network responds.

Rebuilt the sidebar list reveal animation: rows now own their own cascade-in via a useSidebarListReveal hook (Web Animations API, reduced-motion aware) and AgentList rides on the shared LeftMenuTree, so the entrance animation fires reliably on first load and on every Agents ⇄ Projects switch even with virtualization and async hydration.

Expanded desktop Settings with a generic drill-down: clicking Theme swaps the left nav for a breadcrumb and sub-areas (Mode & accent with custom hex, Typography, Layout & density, Custom colors, Effects, Motion, Presets), backed by persisted CSS-variable controls pre-stamped in index.html to avoid flash. Desktop right-click now has Theme and Background entries that deep-link straight into the relevant sub-area.

Polished the agent spec card: theme-aware smoked-black glass that flips with light/dark mode, taskbar-matched 90% glass for both the spec and Telegram panels, one-click copy on IP/Wallet rows with a zscan.live wallet link, a centered nameplate in the metal strip, and an 'Org' label trim.

Reworked the floating chat input: removed the painted backdrop band and instead hard-clip the transcript at the input pill's live-measured midline, align the input to the 680px transcript column, and make the mode selector opaque so chat content no longer bleeds through.

Restyled the public marketing surface: Changelog/Feedback/Models banners picked up frosted pricing-style glass, the /blog single-post and index pages were reworked after cursor.com/blog with a featured post, 2-up grid, archive table, drop cap, and real author avatar via an updated aura-blog seed action; Vibecoder persona gained a WebGL flow-field background that drifts under reduced motion.

Fixed stalled remote/CEO chat turns: the server now evicts warm chat sessions tied to a recycled VM after recover/restart/start/wake/hibernate, and the standalone-agent chat hook forwards the full error payload so stream_stalled and turn_timeout classify as recoverable and auto-retry instead of surfacing a hard 'Chat stream interrupted' bubble.

Made server-emitted session_active forward the caller's X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP to Mixpanel so the authoritative True DAU events geolocate to the user rather than the server; loopback/missing IPs are dropped so no misleading geo is emitted.

Fixed several sidebar layout issues that surfaced with the rocker: list rows now scroll cleanly under the floating Refer member pill across Agents/Projects/Tasks/Process/Debug/Notes, sidebar items can no longer be text-selected, and the switch plate sits vertically centered between the search pill and the first agent row.

Hardened the model picker: unified two type styles across the menu, normalized header padding, and extracted a shared useFlyoutAnchor hook so the effort/council hover flyouts recompute position on scroll/resize and stay anchored to their row instead of floating away after layout shifts on Edge.

highlights: Public /blog site backed by storage-backed Notes
Agents ⇄ Projects rocker with a persistent chat surface
Settings → Theme drill-down with typography, layout, and motion
Stalled remote agent turns now auto-recover
